q: Why does cosine similarity ignore vector length?
options: It uses only the first dimension
It divides the dot product by both vectors’ lengths
explain: Normalizing by length leaves only the angle between vectors.

q: What does cosine similarity ignore that the dot product includes?
About how many FLOPs does multiplying an m × k matrix by a k × n matrix take?
explain: One multiply and one add per term.

q: Why does LoRA work with small ranks?
options: Fine-tuning updates are approximately low-rank, concentrated in a few directions
explain: Singular values of updates decay quickly.
